value.rationale: The representation space for the natural two-loop radical-square-zero local algebra has two intrinsic individual nilpotent Jordan types (fixed by ranks r,s) and a meaningful image-intersection invariant t. Their full joint q-enumeration, feasibility boundaries and smooth rational geometric strata for every size and finite field are structural rather than arbitrary small numerical slices. The result refines known aggregate/module-incidence counts and can be used for representation-variety point counts and rank-conditioned probability laws.
